q1_issues.issue: The past perfect "had molted" carries Past but no Before ordering, although the text supplies other asserted events (the walking, the collecting) for it to precede — the rule excludes the ordering only when there is no other event in the text.
Same omission for the past perfect "had fallen": Past only, with no Before against the later collecting/weighing events.

"Feathers had fallen" gets the group event but no per-member distribution rule, though fall is distributive and the parse does emit that rule for the other two distributive plural subjects (indices 17 and 26).

q2_gaps: intransitive subject of "fall" (feathers falling to the ground): the role rules conflict rather than being silent — "un-powered relocation … drifting or dropped things" → Theme versus "a non-volitional natural process … a mass moved by gravity (rain fell)" → Patient — and no tie-breaker is given, so the parse's Theme is unarbitrated
notes: The rest is by the book: Day/Year/morning time terms, group+Cardinality for the counted plurals with the per-member rules, CoAgent for "with Tessa Brae", During for "the hunt" with the anchor event-noun typed and nothing else, the 41-of-the-fallen-feathers partitive reusing the earlier feather group as superset, "the Watch" as a capitalized common noun with no Name atom, and sky_cat / feather_bin genus-only decomposition.
